app.name: Hoardex
app.tagline: Your Steam library, at a glance.

entry.label: Your Steam profile
entry.placeholder: Profile URL, custom name or SteamID64
entry.invalid: That does not look like a Steam profile. Try a profile URL, a custom name or a SteamID64.
entry.hint: Enter your own profile. It and its game details must be public.
entry.demo: Or explore a demo library with fictional data.

profile.demoNotice: This is a demo with a fictional library. No real Steam account is involved.

notFound.title: Profile not found
notFound.body: We could not find that Steam profile. Check the URL, custom name or SteamID64.

profilePrivate.title: This profile is private
profilePrivate.body: If this is your profile, set “My profile” to Public in your Steam privacy settings. Changes can take about a minute to show up here.

libraryPrivate.title: The game library is private
libraryPrivate.body: The profile is public but its game details are not. If this is your profile, set “Game details” to Public in your Steam privacy settings. Changes can take about a minute to show up here.

wishlistPrivate.title: The wishlist is private
wishlistPrivate.body: If this is your profile, set “Game details” to Public in your Steam privacy settings. Changes can take about a minute to show up here.

rateLimited.title: Steam is busy
rateLimited.body: Steam is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.

upstream.title: Something went wrong
upstream.body: We could not reach Steam or got an unexpected answer. Try again in a moment.

years.title: Hours by year of last play
years.locked: Steam did not share when these games were last played, so there is nothing to chart. If this is your profile, you can review your privacy settings.
